highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Chrome m152 renderer and its upstream stability fixes.
highlights_body: This release candidate also updates HarfBuzzSharp and continues platform and runtime compatibility improvements.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the Chrome m152 upstream fix set.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Contributed platform support improvements for the 4.152 line
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Contributed runtime and build compatibility improvements
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Contributed rendering and platform support improvements

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.152 line with platform, runtime, and HarfBuzzSharp updates.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 incorporated the Chrome m152 renderer and final compatibility work.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp for the 4.152 release line and refreshes its bundled native dependency.
